description: This Java class defines strategies for handling connectivity commands related to connection creation within the Eclipse Ditto project. It manages a set of strategies for processing signals on existing connections, including error handling for inaccessible connections.

classes.name: ConnectionCreatedStrategies
classes.description: A singleton class that manages a set of strategies for handling connectivity commands related to connection creation, extending AbstractCommandStrategies.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ConnectionCreatedStrategies.

methods.name: newCreatedStrategies
methods.description: Initializes and returns a new set of strategies for connection creation handling.

methods.name: isDefined
methods.description: Indicates that the command is always considered defined to forward signals.

methods.name: unhandled
methods.description: Handles commands that are unhandled by returning an error result indicating the connection is not accessible.
